messages:
PagerBot: ALERT: hosted-inference - region us-west - 02:34 UTC - spike in 5xx and client timeouts. p95 latency > 4s, 5xx rate 18% over 10m. Incident channel created.

Ava (ops): I'm in. quick triage — is this auth, gateway, or backend inference?

Devon (eng-oncall): seeing 504s from gateway -> runtime timeouts. KV cache miss rate spiked, batcher queue depth high.

Riley (runtime): confirming: GPU queues at 100% on pool-2, autoscaler didn't kick because min replicas set too low for midnight traffic.

Sasha (support): have multiple customers reporting streaming timeouts and aborted websockets. Escalation from AcmeCorp on call.

Ava (ops): Mitigation steps: 1) raise autoscaler min from 2->4, 2) enable fallback to cpu-quantized model variant for long tail, 3) temporarily raise request timeout in api-gateway to 35s. Devon/Riley take?

Devon (eng-oncall): doing autoscaler change now. patch: kubectl patch hpa inference-pool-2 --patch 'spec.minReplicas:4'

Riley (runtime): enabling fallback route policy -> model: redwood-small-quant-q4. Patch config:

Riley (runtime): ```json
{\"routing\": {\"fallback\": {\"priority\": [\"gpu-opt\",\"quant-cpu\"], \"max_latency_ms\": 30000}}}
```

Devon (eng-oncall): autoscaler changed, replicas scaling to 5. Seeing drop in queue depth.

Ava (ops): good. Sasha please confirm customer-impact comms and quota adjustments.

Sasha (support): Sent initial message to affected customers, offered temporary capacity bump and suggested retry/backoff. AcmeCorp acknowledged, will test.

Support Bot: Note: support ticket #47312 created for AcmeCorp by Sasha.

Devon (eng-oncall): logs showing many 429->retries causing amplification. We should throttle client retries at gateway.

Ava (ops): temporary mitigation -> add rate limit: `limit_req zone=api burst=50 nodelay` on ingress for anonymous keys.

Riley (runtime): rolling restart of proxy sidecars to apply throttling. Applying now.

PagerBot: Update: 5xx rate down to 3% in last 5m, p95 latency fell to 1.2s. Continue monitoring.

Ava (ops): ok start collecting artifacts for postmortem. Items: timeline, root cause (autoscaler thresholds + retry amplification + KV warmup), mitigations applied, customer impact list.

Devon (eng-oncall): repro steps we used for testing:

Devon (eng-oncall): ```bash
# reproduce heavy fanout
for i in {1..2000}; do curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY' -d '{"input":"long prompt"}' & done; wait
```

Riley (runtime): relevant logs snippet:

Riley (runtime): ```
[02:33:41] pool-2 queue_depth=198 gpu_util=99% kv_miss=0.87 error=timeout
[02:34:05] gateway: upstream_timeout -> 504 path=/v1/generate tenant=acmecorp
```

Ava (ops): Action items (owners):

Ava (ops): - Increase default autoscaler min for night windows to 4 (Devon)
- Add KV cache warmup during deploys and cold-starts (Riley)
- Tighten client retry guidance and add gateway-side retry cap (Devon)
- Update runbook w/ fallback enablement steps (Ava)
- Create alert for retry amplification pattern (SRE team) (Riley)
- Customer follow-up summary and credits (Sasha)

Devon (eng-oncall): will open PR for autoscaler default and add telemetry events for retry amplification.

Riley (runtime): will schedule a task to add translucent warmup on pool creation; timeline 2 weeks.

Sasha (support): will send detailed customer postmortem tomorrow and offer 10% credits to affected accounts.

Ava (ops): any outstanding items before we close war room?

Devon (eng-oncall): verify that fallback route remains in place for 24h. I'll monitor.

Sasha (support): AcmeCorp verified improvement during tests. :thumbsup: 

PagerBot: War room closed by Ava at 03:05 UTC. Postmortem doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/postmortems/3185550000-hosted-inference-timeouts

Ava (ops): Closing notes: we'll run tabletop next week to validate runbook. Thanks all.
